candidates.claim: Default range never applies if the panel host has no settings object; the panel silently opens on 7d and never reads the saved setting.
candidates.trigger: 1. User sets Default range to 30d (orca-plugin.json:88-100 declares it). 2. Panel mounts; firstLoad() (panel.js:595) calls readDefaultRange(). 3. If Orca's panel global `orca` has no `settings` property, host?.settings?.get?.() is undefined (panel.js:625). 4. range is undefined, fails the RANGE_DAYS guard (panel.js:627), state.defaultRange stays '7d'. 5. Panel opens on 7d; onDidChange (panel.js:596) is never bound either. Clear-range returns to 7d.
candidates.wrong: Should read the saved Default range from whatever host call the panel can actually make. Repo has no panel-side settings API: the only settings.get callers are worker-side (src/worker.mjs:353, 371 via orca.host.call). Tests pass only because mountPanel injects orca.settings (tests/panel.test.mjs:138), the same guessed shape.
candidates.confidence: medium; assumption that Orca panel host lacks settings. Settle with Orca panel host API docs or a live panel run with saved defaultRange 30d.
candidates.class: feature depends on an unverified host API shape; guards swallow the missing call silently
candidates.sweep: Same guessed shape at panel.js:596 (onDidChange) and index.html:2041, 2070 (checked-broken by same reasoning, unverified). Worker settings path src/worker.mjs:353, 371 uses orca.host.call('settings.get') (checked-fine: different side, real call). Panel request helper not read: not checked.

candidates.claim: When the newest Default range read fails and an older read answers later, state.defaultRange changes after the panel already loaded on the old range, so the view and the clear-range target disagree.
candidates.trigger: 1. Panel mounts; firstLoad (panel.js:595) starts read R1 (defaultRangeReads=1), host get pending. 2. User changes Default range to 30d; onDidChange (panel.js:596) starts R2 (defaultRangeReads=2). 3. R2 rejects or answers an invalid value; defaultRangeApplied stays 0; R2 is newest, so waiters resolve (panel.js:631-636). 4. firstLoad resumes (panel.js:603): state.defaultRange is still 7d; slow timer (panel.js:599) already loaded 7d; no reload. 5. R1 answers '30d': read 1 < 0 is false, so panel.js:629 writes state.defaultRange = 30d. 6. Nothing re-moves state.range. View stays 7d; clearFilter('range') (panel.js:158) goes to 30d.
candidates.wrong: Late valid answer should either move the view (if still unpicked) or not be applied silently. Currently the stored default and the shown range diverge until the next clear.
candidates.confidence: medium; needs host to reject the newer read and answer the older one late. Settle with a test: newer read rejects, older answers '30d' after firstLoad resumed.
candidates.class: post-resolution write to shared state that the awaiting caller already consumed
candidates.sweep: Only readDefaultRange writes state.defaultRange besides the init (panel.js:158 reads it). Test 'a valid Default range answer is kept when a newer read fails' (tests/panel.test.mjs:349) covers the opposite order only, checked-fine for that order.
